title: Promoting Cu-ZnOx Interface Formation and Zn-H-Zn Activation in Industrial CuZnAl Catalysts via ZrO2 Doping for Methanol Synthesis
extraction_notes: The provided Supporting Information pages contain only characterization/physicochemical data (N2 adsorption, TEM, XPS, N2O titration, CO2-TPD correlation, DRIFTS, H2 chemisorption/TPD, pore/metal-content tables, reduction and adsorption properties). No experimental CO2 hydrogenation-to-methanol catalyst-performance entries (conversion, selectivity, methanol STY/rate under reaction conditions) are reported in the SI, so no records were extracted.
